notes: This report draws on public data from Ember, the IEA, China's National Energy Administration and National Bureau of Statistics, the China Electricity Council, BNEF and others to review what happened to the world's and China's power systems in 2025, and what to watch in 2026. Global generation figures all come from Ember. Where the IEA reads the year differently, we say so. Every 2026 figure is marked as year-to-date or a forecast. Ember puts the headline this way: outside a major global downturn, fossil generation stopped growing for the first time.
